# Data Wrangling
```{r data wrangling}

df_name <- read_excel("./12-5-22+Facial+Image+Ratings+for+Twitter+experiment+%23115446_December+7%2C+2022_13.40 Qualtrics.xlsx", n_max = 0) %>%
            names()

df_name <- str_replace(df_name, "_6_TEXT" , "TEXT")

# Read the Excel file
df_Qualtrics <- read_excel("./12-5-22+Facial+Image+Ratings+for+Twitter+experiment+%23115446_December+7%2C+2022_13.40 Qualtrics.xlsx",
                            skip = 2,
                            col_names = df_name) 

df_name2 <- read_excel("12-5-22%282%29+Facial+Image+Ratings+for+Twitter+experiment+Part2_December+8%2C+2022_20.54 Qualtrics2.xlsx", n_max = 0) %>%
            names()

df_name2 <- str_replace(df_name2, "_6_TEXT" , "TEXT")

df_Qualtrics2 <- read_excel("12-5-22%282%29+Facial+Image+Ratings+for+Twitter+experiment+Part2_December+8%2C+2022_20.54 Qualtrics2.xlsx",
                            skip = 2,
                            col_names = df_name2) %>%
  select(!contains("Filter")) %>%  
  select(!contains("_url")) %>%  
  select(!contains("_DO_"))  


df_name3 <- read_excel(list.files(".", "Qualtrics3.xlsx"),
                      n_max = 0) %>%
  names()
df_name3 <- str_replace(df_name3, "_6_TEXT" , "TEXT")

df_Qualtrics3 <- read_excel(list.files(".", "Qualtrics3.xlsx"),
                              skip = 2,
                              col_names = df_name3) %>%
  select(!contains("Filter")) %>%
  select(!contains("_url")) %>%
  select(!contains("_DO_"))

df_Qualtrics <- bind_rows(df_Qualtrics, df_Qualtrics2, df_Qualtrics3)

df_Qualtrics_long <- df_Qualtrics %>%
  mutate(across(`1_age`:`10_Humanness`, as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `1_age`:`10_Humanness`, 
               names_to = c("ImageNo", "Attributes"),
               names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)",
               values_to = "Value")

df_Qualtrics_long$ImageNo <- gsub("_race_6.*", "", df_Qualtrics_long$ImageNo)
unique(df_Qualtrics_long$ImageNo)

df_Qualtrics_l2w <- df_Qualtrics_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Attributes",
              values_from = "Value")

df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo_Names <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(df_Qualtrics_l2w)) {
  if (df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo[i] == "9"){
    df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo_Names[i] <- df_Qualtrics_l2w$CFD_1[i]
  } else if (df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo[i] == "10") {
    df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo_Names[i] <- df_Qualtrics_l2w$CFD_2[i]
  } else {
    df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo_Names[i] <- df_Qualtrics_l2w[i, paste0("AI_", df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo[i])]
  }

}

df_Qualtrics_l2w <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>% 
  mutate(Label = case_when(
    str_detect(ImageNo_Names, "^B") ~ "B",
    str_detect(ImageNo_Names, "^W") ~ "W",
    str_detect(ImageNo_Names, "^C") ~ "C"))

na_counts <- colSums(is.na(df_Qualtrics_l2w))
print("Number of NA values in each column:")
print(na_counts)
df_Qualtrics_l2w <- df_Qualtrics_l2w[complete.cases(df_Qualtrics_l2w$attractive), ]

df_Qualtrics_l2w$age <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$age)
df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo)
df_Qualtrics_l2w$gender <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$gender)
df_Qualtrics_l2w$race <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$race)
df_Qualtrics_l2w$attractive <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$attractive)
df_Qualtrics_l2w$prototypical <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$prototypical)
df_Qualtrics_l2w$emotion <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$emotion)
df_Qualtrics_l2w$Humanness <- as.numeric(df_Qualtrics_l2w$Humanness)

```

Humanness Group: 

```{r}

# Summary Stats 
gender <- table(df_Qualtrics_l2w$gender[!is.na(df_Qualtrics_l2w$gender)])
print(gender)
race <- table(df_Qualtrics_l2w$race[!is.na(df_Qualtrics_l2w$race)])
print(race)
psych::describe(df_Qualtrics_l2w$emotion) 
humanness_cols <- c("1_Humanness", "2_Humanness", "9_Humanness",
                    "3_Humanness", "4_Humanness", "5_Humanness", 
                    "6_Humanness", "7_Humanness", "8_Humanness", "10_Humanness")

df_Qualtrics$RowMeans_Humanness <- rowMeans(df_Qualtrics[humanness_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
psych::describe(df_Qualtrics$RowMeans_Humanness)

psych::describe(df_Qualtrics_l2w$attractive)
psych::describe(df_Qualtrics_l2w$prototypical) 

# Age - Distribution
temp_age <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names, age) %>%
  summarise(Age_Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(ImageNo_Names = as.character(ImageNo_Names)) %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  filter(Age_Count == max(Age_Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  rename("AgeGroup" = age,
         "AgeGroup_MaxCount" = Age_Count)

# Raters per Image
temp_N <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  summarise(N_RaterCount = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(ImageNo_Names = as.character(ImageNo_Names)) 

# Race - Distribution
temp_race <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names, race) %>%
  summarise(race_Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(ImageNo_Names = as.character(ImageNo_Names)) %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  filter(race_Count == max(race_Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  rename("RaceGroup" = race,
         "RaceGroup_MaxCount" = race_Count)

# Gender - Distribution
temp_gender <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names, gender) %>%
  summarise(gender_Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(ImageNo_Names = as.character(ImageNo_Names)) %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  filter(gender_Count == max(gender_Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  rename("GenderGroup" = gender,
         "GenderGroup_MaxCount" = gender_Count)

# Summary statistics
df_summary_mean <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  group_by(ImageNo_Names) %>%
  get_summary_stats(age:Humanness, show = "mean") %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", 
              values_from = "mean") %>%
  mutate(ImageNo_Names = as.character(ImageNo_Names)) %>%
  arrange(ImageNo_Names) 

# Display the results
print(temp_age)
print(temp_N)
print(temp_race)
print(temp_gender)
print(df_summary_mean)

df_summary_mean2 <- df_summary_mean %>%
  left_join(., temp_N, by = "ImageNo_Names") %>%
  left_join(., temp_age, by = "ImageNo_Names") %>%
  left_join(., temp_gender, by = "ImageNo_Names") %>%
  left_join(., temp_race, by = "ImageNo_Names") 

df_summary_mean2 <- df_summary_mean2 %>%
  mutate(AgeGroup_MaxCount_percent = AgeGroup_MaxCount / N_RaterCount,
         GenderGroup_MaxCount_percent = GenderGroup_MaxCount / N_RaterCount,
         RaceGroup_MaxCount_percent = RaceGroup_MaxCount / N_RaterCount
  )

temp_age <- temp_age %>% distinct(ImageNo_Names, .keep_all = TRUE)
temp_race <- temp_race %>% distinct(ImageNo_Names, .keep_all = TRUE)
df_summary_mean2 <- df_summary_mean %>%
  left_join(temp_N, by = "ImageNo_Names") %>%
  left_join(temp_age, by = "ImageNo_Names") %>%
  left_join(temp_gender, by = "ImageNo_Names") %>%
  left_join(temp_race, by = "ImageNo_Names")

print(df_summary_mean2)


t.test(Humanness ~ Label, df_Qualtrics_l2w %>% subset(Label != "C"))
t.test(Humanness ~ Label, df_Qualtrics_l2w %>% subset(Label != "B"))
t.test(Humanness ~ Label, df_Qualtrics_l2w %>% subset(Label != "W"))

cor.test(df_Qualtrics_l2w$attractive, df_Qualtrics_l2w$Humanness)
cor.test(df_Qualtrics_l2w$emotion, df_Qualtrics_l2w$Humanness)
cor.test(df_Qualtrics_l2w$prototypical, df_Qualtrics_l2w$Humanness)

 write.csv(df_summary_mean2, "Images_Means.csv")

t.test(df_Qualtrics_l2w$attractive[df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo_Names == "White05.jpg"],
       df_Qualtrics_l2w$attractive[df_Qualtrics_l2w$ImageNo_Names == "White05.jpg"],
       var.equal = TRUE)
```


```{r}

# List of image filenames to include
included_images <- c("Black02.jpg", "Black05.jpg", "Black21.jpg", "Black22.jpg", "Black24.jpg", 
                     "Black25.jpg", "Black26.jpg", "Black27.jpg", "Black28.jpg", "White15.jpg", 
                     "White16.jpg", "White31.jpg", "White32.jpg", "White33.jpg", "White34.jpg", 
                     "White37.jpg", "White38.jpg", "White40.jpg")

# Subset the data to only include the listed images
subset_data <- df_Qualtrics_l2w %>%
  filter(ImageNo_Names %in% included_images)

t.test(subset_data$attractive[subset_data$Label == "W"],
       subset_data$attractive[subset_data$Label == "B"],
       var.equal = TRUE)
apa.1way.table(iv = Label, dv = attractive, data = subset_data)
t.test(subset_data$Humanness[subset_data$Label == "W"],
       subset_data$Humanness[subset_data$Label == "B"],
       var.equal = TRUE)
apa.1way.table(iv = Label, dv = Humanness, data = subset_data)

```
